name: Hire and Develop the Best
definition: Leaders raise the performance level of the team with every hire and promotion. We hire for the long-term need. We recognize exceptional talent and invest resources to develop their full potential. We empower them to pursue growth through internal rotations.

rows.situation: When the role has been open for months
rows.under: Hires the best of the people who applied, and the bar drops.
rows.justRight: Keeps the role open. A wrong hire costs more than a slow one.
rows.over: Holds out for someone who does not exist while the team burns out covering the gap.

rows.situation: When you hire for the work in front of you
rows.under: Hires for exactly today's task and outgrows the person within a year.
rows.justRight: Hires for the long-term need and the level the job will reach.
rows.over: Hires far above the work, and loses the person to boredom in six months.

rows.situation: When a strong performer has stopped growing
rows.under: Keeps them where they are because they are useful there.
rows.justRight: Opens a rotation or a harder problem, even when it costs your own team.
rows.over: Moves people so often that nobody stays long enough to own an outcome.

rows.situation: When it is time to promote
rows.justRight: Promotes people already doing the next job, so the bar rises with every promotion.
rows.over: Sets a bar nobody clears, and the best people leave to be promoted elsewhere.

rows.situation: When someone is not meeting the bar
rows.under: Waits and hopes, and tells them everything is fine.
rows.justRight: Says it early and specifically, and gives real support and a real deadline.
rows.over: Manages people out at the first weak quarter and loses people who were about to compound.

rows.situation: When developing someone costs your own time
rows.under: Treats development as something the training team owns.
rows.justRight: Spends the hours yourself. Gives the hard, visible work away and coaches through it.
rows.over: Coaches so constantly that the person never gets to fail and learn anything.
